name: Endgame_Gear_Web_Configurator
description: Web-based configurator for Endgame Gear wireless mice (XM2w/OP1w, 4k) over WebHID

scripts.check:ui: python re/layout_check.py && python re/i18n_check.py && python re/render_check.py && python re/reset_check.py
scripts.verify: npm run check:meta && npm run check && npm run lint && npm run lint:docs && npm run lint:css && npm run test && npm run check:i18n && npm run check:ui && npm run build
scripts.verify:ci: npm run check:meta && npm run check && npm run lint && npm run lint:docs && npm run lint:css && npm run test && npm run check:i18n && npm run build
